Name: Dishan
Summary: Dishan was a son of Seir the Horite, and the father of Uz and Aran.
KeyStory: Dishan is named among Seir's sons and among the dukes of the Horites.
RelatedPeople: Seir; Uz, Son of Dishan; Aran
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
